mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_content_translations ( resource_type, resource_id, content_version, source_language, target_language, translated_content ) VALUES ( #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{contentVersion}, #{sourceLanguage}, #{targetLanguage}, #{translatedContent} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_language = VALUES(source_language), translated_content = VALUES(translated_content), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
